question: Simplify x(7x − 4) + 2(x² − 2) + 11.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the brackets directly and combine like terms.

⇒ 7x² − 4x + 2x² − 4 + 11

⇒ 9x² − 4x + 7

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² − 4x + 7.**
